title: Checkout requests stall during flash sale
summary: Checkout users waited 6 seconds because Redis had no free connections left in the pool during peak traffic.

title: Checkout API timing out on cart lookups
summary: The checkout API spent several seconds waiting for Redis because every client slot in the connection pool was already busy.

title: Checkout slows down when promotions go live
summary: Redis reported no free connections and checkout latency rose above 5 seconds for most purchase attempts.

title: Payment service waits on cache connection slots
summary: Payment service threads were blocked because the shared Redis pool was exhausted and new requests could not borrow a connection.

title: Session service saturates Redis pool after traffic burst
summary: Session lookups started hanging because Redis connection capacity was exhausted once mobile traffic spiked.

title: Session service unstable during Redis failover
summary: Session service calls kept timing out because Redis clients retried all at once after a failover event.

title: Auth service loses sessions after cache node flap
summary: Auth service requests timed out on Redis while every caller retried immediately and amplified the failover storm.

title: User API times out after Redis node election
summary: After a Redis node election the user API retried without backoff and request timeouts spread across the cluster.

title: Session service keeps hammering Redis during outage
summary: Redis was recovering but the session service retried immediately on every timeout, making the outage last longer.

title: Checkout API retries overwhelm Redis recovery
summary: Checkout API calls timed out and every worker retried Redis instantly instead of waiting between attempts.

title: Order processor stops accepting events
summary: Kafka disks filled up and producers were rejected because topic retention kept too much historical data on each broker.

title: Notification service queue freezes on Kafka storage
summary: Kafka brokers ran out of disk and the notification service could not publish any more messages to the event bus.

title: Analytics processor blocked by full Kafka brokers
summary: Analytics processor traffic backed up because Kafka storage crossed 95% and brokers entered a read-only state.

title: Event processor cannot push messages to Kafka
summary: The event processor saw Kafka reject writes because topic logs had consumed almost all broker disk space.

title: Order processor stalls from Kafka disk pressure
summary: Producers to Kafka started failing once broker disks filled up because retention on hot topics was far too long.

title: Payment service CPU pinned by retry loop
summary: Payment service hit 100% CPU because a failed downstream call triggered an infinite retry loop without exponential backoff.

title: Billing API burns CPU after partner errors
summary: Billing API threads spun in an infinite loop and CPU saturated because retries fired immediately on every gateway failure.

title: Payment worker locked at 100 percent CPU
summary: Payment worker processing saturated CPU because the same downstream call retried forever instead of backing off between attempts.

title: Checkout service loops on failed dependency
summary: Checkout service CPU spiked because each failed payment request entered an infinite retry loop with no backoff strategy.

title: Payment service degrades under CPU saturation
summary: A broken client retried the same request continuously and pushed payment service CPU to 100 percent within minutes.

title: Order service slows after new report query
summary: PostgreSQL response times exploded because a new orders query scanned the table without the right index.

title: Order service database goes from milliseconds to seconds
summary: Every PostgreSQL query turned slow because the latest release added a filter that forced a full table scan without an index.

title: API gateway sees slow reads from PostgreSQL
summary: The API gateway waited seconds on PostgreSQL because a missing index caused heavy query overload on a large orders table.

title: Order service query storm after feature launch
summary: A recent feature pushed PostgreSQL into slow queries because the application hammered an unindexed status filter.

title: Orders API degraded by unindexed database call
summary: Orders API latency climbed because PostgreSQL had to scan millions of rows for a query that should have used an index.

title: API gateway returns 502 after ingress certificate expiry
summary: Nginx at the API gateway could not open TLS sessions because an internal certificate expired overnight.

title: Gateway fails handshakes to internal services
summary: The gateway started serving 502 errors because nginx was using an expired TLS certificate for upstream connections.

title: Auth service unreachable through nginx mesh
summary: Nginx on the mesh edge rejected TLS traffic because the certificate used for internal auth calls had expired.

title: API gateway breaks after missed certificate rotation
summary: Gateway traffic failed once the nginx certificate expired and upstream TLS sessions could no longer be established.

title: Gateway outage caused by stale TLS certificate
summary: Nginx at the API gateway served 502 errors because its internal service certificate expired before the planned rotation window.
